beur-hagra/1:א: Seif 1 — one should be careful to kasher before the fifth hour etc. So too Tosafot Chullin 108b s.v. shenafal and Avodah Zarah 76a s.v. mikan and Rosh and Mordechai chapter Kol HaShaah that before the fifth hour it is still heter and noten taam bar noten taam d'heter and need not be concerned in all this; and even per Tosafot Chullin 111b in name of Rashi only rose but not cooked — see there s.v. halachta here there are three noten taam from chametz to vessel and vessel to water and water to vessel and all agree as siman 447 seif 5 hagahah; however etc. and even though stringent there l'chatchila general stringency there specifically; not so after four hours when prohibition applies and like pot in which meat cooked one may not cook milk etc. for second taste is in prohibition as Rosh there s.k. 29; and same for many noten taam specifically in heter; and Rava does not dispute Abaye there 110:11b — Rava said when absorbs etc. only first taste; see Tosafot s.v. amar; and Yoreh De'ah siman 95; then must be careful as written; but per Ramban chametz is called prohibition even before prohibition time — no difference; even before prohibition time must be careful; and Ran chapter Kol HaBasar on Tosafot above before four hours; and possible to distinguish etc.; and Terumat HaDeshen house 4 beginning Shach that even before fifth must be careful in all per his view chametz not called heter; and as written not as Magen Avraham s.k. 1 for in prohibition no difference between two noten taam or more; see 123b; and see Rashba siman 462; already explained siman 451 that Rif, Rosh, and Shulchan Aruch follow Ramban.
beur-hagra/1:ב: If the vessels — fat in hot water is taste for enhancement; we do not permit in Avodah Zarah 38b hot water except because stam etc. Tosafot and Rosh; meaning even though they said Chullin 108b absorbs absorbs expels does not expel what absorbs now as Rabbenu Tam explained there in Tosafot — in clear water there is no absorption only mixture. There.
beur-hagra/1:ד: And similarly if one kasher etc. — meaning even per Rashbam who Tosafot wrote there: as we say absorbs absorbs expels does not expel all time absorbing — and same expels expels absorbs does not absorb all time expelling — so Raavyah and Rosh chapter 2 seif 7; and even though Tosafot rejected this view — per Rabbenu Tam he does not expel at all current absorption — we could say opposite; but per Rashbam to say all time busy expelling does not absorb is certainly true view as Raavad chapter 2 Pesachim; and we find this view in many places; but what they are stringent is in such case where vessel of slight absorption quickly expels from other vessel and then absorbs — and all time they are ben yomo and no sixty in water against them; and entire this seif until end deals only with such case where we are stringent because of Rabbenu Tam who disputes Rashbam — for him expels always; and if we held view Tosafot rejected then permitted in one vessel if kasher once even leaving very long; but Tosafot already rejected; and general rule per Rabbenu Tam no remedy after fifth except not ben yomo or sixty; per Rashbam helps if not leaving long.
beur-hagra/1:ה: And similarly if one leaves — per above view that all time expelling does not absorb — forbidden to leave more than measure of its expulsion as Tur wrote.
beur-hagra/1:ו: And he does not leave — meaning per Rashbam there in Tosafot absorbs absorbs etc. all time absorbing does not expel; when full from absorbing then expels; and he said there when rests again expels — meaning when rests from absorbing then again expels; and answers when preceded and removed before full from absorbing and does not expel at all even from another absorption — not as Rabbenu Tam there; and Rashbam wrote there therefore must leave in hagalah long time until etc.; and Rif and Rosh chapter 2 and Rambam; and Orach Chayyim in name of Raavad; and Rabbenu Tam challenged him; and Tur in name of Raavyah on Rif who knows to estimate etc. perhaps leaves inside and return and absorb — therefore God-fearing person etc. before fifth hour etc. — meaning then may leave much inside per Rif and Rashbam.
beur-hagra/1:ז: And similarly so that — per Rabbenu Tam view all time expelling does not absorb; and Gemara says there specifically fell into boiling pot then absorbed etc.; and same for expelling as above; and challenges six seifim when rests etc. — meaning from its boiling when preceded and removed; however many dispute etc. — meaning as Semak wrote hagalah at yad soledes bo does not help except boiling that raises boiling; and Magen Avraham; and Kol Bo in name of Kol Bo; and six seifim when rests etc.; but appears boiling also not needed at all before fifth hour for we hold yad soledes bo in twenty-four in kli rishon; but here Semak reason as Chullin fell into boiling pot and therefore not to exclude yad soledes bo for otherwise all permitted; and he said however many dispute hold Semak reason because as absorbs in boiling so expels in boiling — so Beit HaGolah in plain Shulchan Aruch; and implied chapter Kol HaBasar 2 in boiling and kli rishon; and one may reject for Gemara Shabbat pot and kettle passed from boiling and there yad soledes bo suffices; but truth shoots his way plain Shulchan Aruch as Beit Yosef Kol Bo; and he said not cease etc.; and also not insert etc.; and as fell into boiling pot — meaning to exclude that afterward reboiled; and as above perhaps absorbs; and Beit Yosef Kol Bo see there.
beur-hagra/1:ט: And last — absorbed from vessels that water stayed inside much; and all the more if kashered first; and when no sixty in water against vessels and they ben yomo; if not ben yomo taste impaired and noten taam bar noten taam d'heter even though noten taam lifgam l'chatchila forbidden; nevertheless in such case noten taam bar noten taam permitted even l'chatchila; and need sixty in pot against all vessels; then no need kasher at end; and hagahah above; or if there is etc. — meaning kashering one vessel; but many vessels need sixty against all — not as Rosh chapter 2 seif 7 wrote each vessel etc.; and Rashba siman 462; even though Orlah chapter 2 terumah elevates etc.; and orlah with orlah there to two hundred; and terumah in hundred; but if added until noten taam forbidden as Yerushalmi end halacha 4 beans cooked with lentils of heter without noten taam — if added beans species awakens species to forbid — should not be greater than two hundred as you say in two hundred you see heter as if not that prohibition — if has noten taam forbidden and if not permitted; here you see heter as if not that prohibition — if has noten taam forbidden and if not permitted — meaning as if not mixed at all and returns and reawakens; this said if added beans of terumah forbidden; as Bechorot 22-23 found mixture and reawakening; and Tosafot Avodah Zarah 73a first first nullified until noten taam; and Bechorot there and other places; Yoreh De'ah siman 99 seif 6 hagahah.
beur-hagra/1:י: And if etc. then etc. — and does not help what there is sixty in water; and also does not help what not ben yomo for noten taam lifgam on Pesach forbidden as siman 447; and per his view wrote after six hours noten taam lifgam permitted; and nullified in sixty as seif 2.
beur-hagra/1:כ: Must be careful — meaning there should be sixty in water or not ben yomo; but all permissions of not leaving much and not ceasing etc. do not help if were ben yomo and no sixty in water — Tosafot already rejected; and Rashba siman 463 this view always absorbs — therefore no remedy except as above; and Shulchan Aruch wrote thus for clarity that even lenient views nevertheless must be careful etc.; therefore good to kasher before fifth hour but not for law.

chok-yaakov/1:א: Before fifth hour — meaning beginning fifth hour end fourth as siman 443; so explicitly Tosafot, Rosh chapter HaShocheir Et HaPoel, Pesachim, chapter Kol HaShaah, Mordechai, Ran, and all poskim; and Tur wording before us; not as some Tur books error wrote before six; Acharonim agreed word in reason since from fourth hour forbidden d'rabbanan — not called noten taam bar noten taam d'heter; must be careful these matters — sixty in water against vessel or vessel not ben yomo. Question on Rama who here rules like Mechaber without disputant and at end wrote when kasher before Pesach after six must be careful in all matters — implies before six no care needed; how rule lenient against most poskim; Taz, Magen Avraham, Netiv Chayyim noted; cannot say Rama view stringent from sixth even if not ben yomo or sixty must care in all other matters — per what we hold siman 446 seif 2 after six until Pesach not forbidden in any amount and noten taam lifgam permitted; if sixty or not ben yomo no care — noten taam bar noten taam d'heter; if no sixty and ben yomo from fourth also must care all matters since no noten taam bar noten taam d'heter forbidden d'rabbanan anyway; Kol Bo also wrote like Rama before six and after six; but no proof from his words for he follows poskim who hold from sixth forbidden in any amount and noten taam lifgam forbidden; what Mishna Berurah above siman 446 seif 20 hagahah on noten taam lifgam permitted in my humble opinion all agree — poskim who hold forbidden in any amount also noten taam lifgam forbidden interconnected; Beit Yosef see Kol Bo and 23; therefore ruled stringent if kasher after six even if not ben yomo and sixty must care all matters like during Pesach; question on Mechaber; possible Mechaber intent stringent like Kol Bo after six even if sixty and not ben yomo must care all matters; even though ruled above from sixth nullified in sixty and noten taam lifgam permitted specifically b'dieved not to forbid; for hagalah l'chatchila care Kol Bo view; main Mechaber intent.
chok-yaakov/1:ב: So that one need not check if vessels ben yomo — for even if ben yomo also permitted because noten taam bar noten taam d'heter; and even though above siman 447 seif 5 Rama forbids things cooked in vessels and did not permit from noten taam bar noten taam — one may say because in cooking we forbid l'chatchila noten taam bar noten taam as Yoreh De'ah siman 95 and Machatzit HaShekel klal 50 and Netiv Chayyim see there; there called l'chatchila since can eat before Pesach or keep after Pesach; and some say chametz since named on it called prohibition taste; as siman 451 s.k. 14; not so here regarding vessels where many noten taam from food to vessel and vessel to water and water to vessel and returns and expels from vessel to cooked food during Pesach — therefore permit here; so Rosh chapter Kol HaShaah; Magen Avraham not as some Acharonim left here in Netiv Chayyim.

peri-megadim/1:_: Before Taz in letter vav and Magen Avraham letter vav and Chokhmat Adam 1 letter tet — law that from fifth hour prohibition d'rabbanan like d'oraisa and not noten taam bar noten taam d'heter and requires sixty or not ben yomo regarding b'dieved; l'chatchila must be concerned in all matters — even not ben yomo and sixty not leave too long and not cease from boiling; until night noten taam lifgam and any amount forbidden during Pesach; however b'dieved if not careful in all these rely on law until night noten taam lifgam and any amount permitted; not so during Pesach any amount and noten taam lifgam forbidden b'dieved; for us may not kasher any vessel on Pesach and rely on taste busy not absorbing vessels and nature of water absorbs and does not expel — as we need to say there in letter bet at length.
